Jeu d'adresse : pilote un module lunaire: A skill game: fly a lunar module with the main engine (up arrow) and the side thrusters, and land it gently on one of three pads before the fuel runs out. The dashboard turns green when your speed is safe; the small pad multiplies the score by 5 and the fuel left adds to it. Gravity gets stronger with every mission.
Jeu d'adresse : pilote un module spatial: A skill game: fly a space module and land it gently on one of three pads before the fuel runs out. A game is 3 lives and a score that adds up, across four worlds: the Moon, windy Mars, icy Europa where you slide, an asteroid under a meteor shower, with canyons and moving pads. Keyboard, mouse or gamepad, full screen.
